sources.excerpt: Official site identifies Curry Place at 11229 New Hampshire Ave, Silver Spring, MD 20904, phone 301-593-7222, and links its ordering vendors.
Official Silver Spring menu page embeds the current January 2026 two-panel food menu and a duplicate one-page PDF; all 88 distinct food/nonalcoholic presentations were enumerated.
One-page restaurant-issued PDF duplicates the first printed menu panel and includes only a generic ask-us allergy/healthy-needs advisory, not an allergen matrix.
Official catering page embeds the current Curry Place catering menu; all 33 distinct catering presentations were enumerated.

Official homepage-linked Beyond Menu catalog identifies 11229 New Hampshire Ave and exposes 91 current menu presentations. Overlaps were consolidated; five distinct supplemental products were retained.
The frozen packet domain now identifies Curry Place Germantown at 12951 Wisteria Dr, Germantown, MD 20874, phone 301-972-1005; it is not the assigned Silver Spring location.
Targeted official-document search returned no restaurant-issued allergen guide, nutrition guide, ingredient table, or matrix.
Targeted location-specific web search found menus and listings, but no current restaurant-issued allergen matrix.
